trial_title: Biological Therapy in Treating Patients With Glioblastoma Multiforme
brief_summary:
RATIONALE: Biological therapies use different ways to stimulate the immune system and stop cancer cells from growing.

PURPOSE: Phase II trial to study the effectiveness of biological therapy in treating patients with glioblastoma multiforme.

eligibility_table.criterion: Histologically proven glioblastoma multiforme or anaplastic astrocytoma
eligibility_table.justification: Category not evaluable deterministically
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a histologically confirmed diagnosis of glioblastoma multiforme or anaplastic astrocytoma based on recent biopsy results?

eligibility_table.criterion: Age: Over 18
eligibility_table.justification: age 45.0 > 18.0 → True

eligibility_table.criterion: Performance status: ECOG 0-1 OR Karnofsky 70-100%
eligibility_table.justification: Performance status (ECOG or Karnofsky) is not provided.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have an ECOG performance status of 0 or 1, or a Karnofsky score of 70 or higher?

eligibility_table.criterion: WBC greater than 2000/mm3
eligibility_table.justification: No lab values in patient profile
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Is the patient's white blood cell count greater than 2000/mm³?

eligibility_table.criterion: Platelet count greater than 100,000/mm3
eligibility_table.justification: No lab values in patient profile
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Is the patient's current platelet count greater than 100,000/mm3?

eligibility_table.criterion: No active infection with hepatitis B
eligibility_table.justification: No indication of active hepatitis B infection.

eligibility_table.criterion: Not pregnant or nursing
eligibility_table.justification: No information suggests the patient is pregnant or nursing.

eligibility_table.criterion: Fertile patients must use effective contraception during and for 1 month after study
eligibility_table.justification: No information on contraception use is provided.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Is the patient currently using an effective form of contraception, and will he continue to do so during the study and for 1 month after?

eligibility_table.criterion: No active collagen vascular or autoimmune disease
eligibility_table.justification: No active collagen vascular or autoimmune disease reported.

eligibility_table.criterion: No prior severe reaction to any blood product
eligibility_table.justification: No prior severe reaction to blood products mentioned.

eligibility_table.criterion: No other prior malignancy within the past 5 years except adequately treated squamous cell or basal cell skin cancer, carcinoma in situ or the cervix, or stage I or II cancer in complete remission
eligibility_table.justification: Patient has a history of anaplastic astrocytoma, which is a malignancy within the past 5 years.

eligibility_table.criterion: Not immunologically compromised due to chronic conditions
eligibility_table.justification: No indication of immunocompromised status due to chronic conditions.

eligibility_table.criterion: Not allergic by standard skin testing
eligibility_table.justification: No information on allergies by standard skin testing is provided.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient undergone standard skin testing for allergies within the last 12 months, and were the results negative?

eligibility_table.criterion: HIV negative
eligibility_table.justification: No indication of HIV infection.

eligibility_table.criterion: No concurrent biologic therapy with immunomodulatory effects (e.g., interleukin-2, interferon alfa)
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is currently on high-dose steroids, which are considered concurrent corticosteroid therapy.

eligibility_table.criterion: No prior or concurrent local or systemic chemotherapy
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has received multiple cycles of chemotherapy, including temozolomide and CPT-11, which disqualifies them from this criterion.

eligibility_table.criterion: At least 1 week since prior corticosteroid therapy
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is currently receiving high-dose steroids, indicating they have not been off corticosteroid therapy for at least 1 week.

eligibility_table.criterion: No concurrent corticosteroid therapy
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is currently on high-dose steroids, which violates the criterion of no concurrent corticosteroid therapy.

eligibility_table.criterion: See Disease Characteristics
eligibility_table.justification: The specific disease characteristics are not provided, making it impossible to assess this criterion.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a measurable tumor progression as defined by a ≥25% increase in the sum of the longest diameters of the target lesions according to RECIST criteria?

eligibility_table.criterion: No concurrent antiproliferatives or immunosuppressants
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is on multiple medications, including Avastin, which may have immunosuppressive effects, thus violating this criterion.
